news.title: AI is reshaping entry-level work and the talent pipeline
news.summary_en: While entry-level hiring is not disappearing entirely, AI is beginning to influence the work traditionally assigned to early career professionals and is increasing expectations for what entry-level workers can produce from day one, according to a new report.

news.title: Aligning AI with pedagogy, privacy, and outcomes
news.summary_en: In a peer-reviewed study at Los Angeles Pacific University, students using a pedagogically-aligned AI assistant saw a 20 percent increase in GPA, a 13 percent increase in final scores, and a 36 percent increase in intrinsic motivation to learn.
